senses.gloss: --(see मुद्रा devi1s): a group of शक्तिस्. Br. IV. १९. १५.
--a son of Raivata Manu. M. 9. २१.

(II)--the subjects of a king; पृथु treated them with respect;
1: भा. IV. १७. 2; Br. III. ४९. १७; M. ३४. २६; २२६. 6; २४०. ११.
acquiesed in selecting पूरु and also Dyumatsena.
2: Ib. ३६. 5; २१४. १६.
(I)--seven kinds, which support the monarch. भा. VI. १४. १७-18.

(II)--usually eight, the eight places of gods, from ब्रह्मा to पिशाच, eight-fold ऐश्वर्य, the eight रूपस्, etc.
1: Br. IV. 3. २७ to ७३.
regarded as truth and their opposite as false.
2: Ib. IV. 3. ८५.
[page२-401+ ३१]

(III)--seven अव्यक्त, waters, तेजस्, वायु, आकाश, भूतादि and महत् enter gradually and bring about प्रत्याहर;
1: वा. १०२. २६; ४९. १८५.
also eight kinds.
2: Ib. १०२. ९५.
--Brahmam, the first प्रवृत्ति of ईश्वर. वा. 3. 9; ६१. III.
--an Asura follower of Bali. M. २४५. ३२.
--a god of the Lekha group. Br. II. ३६. ७५.
--a son of कृष्ण and माद्री (लक्ष्मणा). भा. X. ६१. १५.
--a goddess enshrined at छागलाण्ड. M. १३. ४३.
--the son of Janamejaya and father of Pra- वीर. Vi. IV. १९. 1.
--a son of Janamejaya and father of Pra- वीर. भा. IX. २०. 2.

(I)--the son of Durdama; had a hundred sons who went to the North as lords of the म्लेच्छस्।
1: भा. IX. २३. १५-16; Br. III. ७४. ११-12; वा. ९९. ११.
Father of शतधर्म.
2: Vi. IV. १७. 4-5.
[page२-402+ २३]
(II) (प्रशान्ति): a name of शन्ति Agni. Br. II. १२. २९; वा. २९. २७.
(III)--a मन्त्रकृत्; see Cyavana. Br. II. ३२. १०४; III. 1. ९२; वा. ६५. ५४, ८८.
(V)--a god of प्रसूत group. Br. II. ३६. ७०.
(VI)--a god of the Lekha group. Br. II. ३६. ७५.
(VII)--one of the Mind-born sons of ब्रह्मा; a मन्त्रकृत्. M. 3. 7; १०२. १९; १४५. ९८; वा. ५९. ९६.
(VIII)--the son of विदुष; had १०० sons, all chieftains of the म्लेच्छ countries of the northern regions. M. ४८. 8-9.
(IX)--the father of the यक्षस्. वा. ६९. ११.
--a प्रजेश्वर. Br. III. 1. ५४.
--the sage who revealed the previous birth of king पुष्पवाहन to him. M. १००. 7; वा. ६२. ७२.

--the collective name of the ten sons of प्राचीनबर्हिष and सामुद्री; commanded by their father they engaged themselves in penance in the [page२-403+ ३६] midst of the ocean and meditated on the teachings of शिव given to them; leaving their home they proceeded to the west and in a park near a great lake heard the divine music; when listening to it, there appeared शिव who on request initiated them in the meditation on विष्णु (रुद्रगीता); when शिव left they meditated under the waters for १००० years. विष्णु appeared before them and promised them a son by asking them to marry the daughter of कण्डु and प्रम्लोचा; pleased with seeing the God they praised Him; after his disappearance they came out of the waters and seeing the earth filled with wild growth they began to burn the trees by breathing spiritual fire and wind from their mouth. ब्रह्मा (Soma) interceded then and prevented them from further destroying the trees by offering वार्क्षि (मारिषा) the daughter of the trees in marriage to them; they married her and she gave birth to दक्ष on the eve of the चाक्षुष epoch.
1: भा. IV. २४ (whole); २५. 1-2; ३० (whole) VI. 4. 4-१७; Br. II. १३. ४०; ३७. २७; M. 4. ४७-9; वा. ६३. २७-9.
After a long period of enjoyment of life they placed their wife under their son दक्ष and went away to the western sea where Jajali attained siddhi; seeing them steadfast in devotion नारद came there, and was welcom- ed by them; requested by them to be instructed to get rid of सम्सार, नारद advised them to worship and contemplate on विष्णु directly, and than departed; they did so and attain- ed the world of विष्णु;
2: भा. IV. ३१. 1-२५.
sacrifice of, when नारद sang praises of Dhruva;
3: Ib. IV. १२. ४०; १३. 2.
worshipped for treasure.
4: Ib. II. 3. 7.
--a son of हविर्धान. Br. II. ३७. २४.
(I)--a son of Kuru. M. ५०. २३.
(II)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६१. ८१. [page२-404+ ३१]
--a मध्यमाध्वर्यु. Br. II. ३३. १६.
--the father of Khanitra. वा. ८६. 4.
(II)--the lord of वैराजक Kalpa; wife गायत्री; son Snigdhasvara. वा. २१. ४१-2.
(III)--the Veda-व्यास of the second द्वापर. Vi. III. 3. ११.
(IV)--the son of प्राम्शु and father of Khanitra. Vi. IV. 1. २३.
--प्रजेश्वरस्; they are Kardama, कश्यप, शेष, विक्रान्त, सुश्राव, Bahuputra, कुमार, विवस्वान्, शुचिश्रवस्, Pracetas, अरिष्टनेमि and Bahula. वा. ६५. ५३-54.
--a तीर्थ between प्रयागा, प्रतिष्- ठान and the वासुकिहृअदा. M. १०४. 5. [page२-405+ २८]
--a Mt. felt the prowess of हिरण्यकशिपु's arms. M. १६३. ८८.
--स्वायम्भुव came out of him. वा. २१. ६०.
--the सप्तऋषिस् as दाराग्णिहोत्रिन्स्. वा. ६१. १००.

--the son of भीमरथ: was a दिवोदास, lord of वारणासि; क्षेमक ruined the city and Nikumbha cursed it to be desolate when the king established himself at Gomati; killed the १०० sons of Bhadrasena and took his kingdom leaving Durmada a son of Bhadrasena to escape as a baby;
1: Br. III. ६७. २६.
father of Pratardhana by दृषद्वती; his wife सुयशा had no son in spite of her worship at Nikumbha's temple.
2: Ib. III. ६७. ४७-67.
--an अमिताभ god of the स्वारोचिस epoch. Br. II. ३६. ५३.
--the brother of Bhaya, Lord of the Yavanas; consumed the city of पुरञ्जन to flames; allegorically the two forms of fever. भा. IV. २७. ३०; २८. ११; २९. २३.
(I)--an अमिताभ god. Br. II. ३६. ५३.
(II)--(ety): all the senses came out of ईश्वर. वा. 4. ३७.

--the top मन्त्र; glorifies ईश्वर; यज्ञ glori- fies प्रणव; मनस् यज्ञ in the form of Rudra; hence [page२-406+ ३२] Paramampadam; ओङ्कारम्, अक्षरम्, ब्रह्मा and three वर्णस्;
2: Ib. ३२. 1.
प्रणवात्मक is ब्रह्मा;
3: Ib. २४. ५१.
is Rudra.
4: Br. II. १३. १३७.
^1 M. ८५. 6; वा. २०. ३८.
--भूह, Bhuva, and Sva. वा. ६१. १०८.
(also प्रणालक)--the water-vent on the पीठ of an image; facing the North. M. २६२, 5 and १६.
--a मरीचि god. Br. IV. 1. ५८.
--an अग्नि named Nabha. Br. II. १२. २३.
--a hell. Br. IV. ३३. ६१.
(I)--see Dyumat. भा. IX. १७. 6.

(II)--a son of दिवोदास; father of Vatsa and Garga;
1: Br. III. ६७. ६७-9; वा. ९२. ६४, ६५.
earned the title, शत्रुजित् by destroying the line of भद्रश्रेणीय; known as Vatsa, so called by his father out of love, and as ऋतध्वज by being truthful. For posses- sing a horse by name कुवलायश्व, he came to be known by that name. Alarka was the son of Vatsa.
2: Vi. IV. 8. ११-16.

(III)--a grandson of ययाति by his daughter who with अष्टक, शिबि and Pratardana was engaged in a sacrifice;
1: M. ३५. 5.
discoursed with ययाति on different worlds and [page२-407+ २५] promised to give those worlds to which he was entitled to; went to heaven with the above.
2: Ib. ३८. २२; ४१. १३-14; ४२. १४, २६ and २८.
--a group of gods, twelve in number, of the epoch of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. २७, ३१. वा. ६२. २४; Vi. III. 1. १४.
--a follower of Bali. M. २४५. ३२.
--a son of उद्गीथ. वा. ३३. ५६.
--the son of कुश and father of सञ्जय. भा. IX. १७. १६; Br. III. 3. ३५.
--the son of Manu and father of कृतरथ. Vi. IV. 5. २७.

--the son of Vasu and father of Oghavan and ओघवती;
1: भा. IX. 2. १८.
the गोदावरि split herself, out of fear of him.
2: M. २२. ५८.
--the son of भानुमत् and father of सुप्रतीक. भा. IX. १२. ११.
--one of the names of the fourth Marut गण. वा. ६७. १२७.
(I)--the son of शमि and father of Svayam- bhoja. Br. III. ७१. १३९; M. ४४. ८०; Vi. IV. १४. २३.
(II)--a son of क्षत्रव्र्द्ध and father of Samjaya. Vi. IV. 9. २५-26. [page२-408+ २६]
--a son of शमि. वा. ९६. १३७.
--a son of प्रतिक्षत्र and father of Bhoja. M. ४४. ८०.
--a son of Maru and father of कीर्तिरथ. वा. ८९. ११.
--one of the names of the Marut गण. वा. ६७. १७८.
--a son of दिलीप, and father of three sons: देवापि, शन्तनु and बाह्लिक. वा. ९९. २३४.
(I)--a son of दिलीप and father of three sons, देवापि and others. भा. IX. २२. ११-12; M. ५०. ३८. वा. ९९. ४१८; Vi. IV. २०. 8-9.

(II)--the first day of the पक्ष; in the bright half, the moon leaves the सूर्यमण्डल and takes the middle place between that मण्डल and that of the moon; the time for sacrifices and oblations;
1: वा. ५६. ३६, ४७.
first of तिथिस्।
2: Ib. ५३. ११४.
--a son of क्षत्रधर्म and father of शृञ्जय (सञ्जय वा। प्।). Br. III. ६८. 7; वा. ९३. 7.

--the first among the तिथिस्;
1: Br. II. २४. १४२.
the first day after the two पर्वस् in the month fit for अन्वाधानक्रिय।
2: Ib. II. २८. ३७.
--one of the sixteen ऋत्विक्स् for यज्ञ; issued from the back of नारायण. M. १६७. 8.
(I)--a son of श्वफल्क. भा. IX. २४. १७.
(II)--the son of Vajra and father of सुबाहु (सुचारु वि। प्। and वा। प्।). भा. X. ९०. ३८; वा. ९६. २५१; Vi. IV. १५. ४१-2. [page२-409+ ३९]
--characteristics of; विद्या, काव्यम्, शिल्पम्, etc. वा. १२. 6-8.
--a son of कृष्ण and सत्यभामा. भा. X. ६१. ११.
--a sage of the second सावर्ण Manu. Br. IV. 1. ७०.
--a god of Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ६०.
--a son of Maru; father of कीर्तिरथ, Br. III. ६४. ११. [page२-410+ २६]
--a daughter of Maru and wife of किम्पुरुष. भा. V. 2. २३.
(II)--a son of Upamadgu. Vi. IV. १४. 9.
--a १०० kings; ruled after the Bhojas. Br. III. ७४. २६७; M. २७३. ७१. वा. ३२. ५०; ९९. ४५३.
--the son of वत्सव्यूह and father of दिवाकर. वा. ९९. २८२.
(I)--a son of वत्सवृद्ध and father of भानु. भा. IX. १२. १०.
(II)--a son of Vatsadroha. M. २७१. 5.
(III)--the son of वत्सव्यूह and father of दिवाकर. Vi. IV. २२. 3.
--a Rudra on the १२थ् cover of the षोडश Cakra. Br. IV. ३४. ३३.
--a son of शान्तिदेवा and Vasudeva. भा. IX. २४. ५०. [page२-411+ ४०]

(II)--a description of the consecration of the लिन्ग in temples;
1: M. ch. २६३.
माघ, फाल्गुण, Caitra, वैशाख, and ज्येष्ठ are auspicious months. The auspicious asterisms, planets and लग्नस् are also mentioned;
2: Ib. २६४. 3-१२.
the मण्टप should lie on the east or north of the temple, of different measure- ments. An altar to be located in its centre. It is a temporary structure for performing the consecration ceremony, मन्त्रस् and music form part of the ritual. The image to be then installed. The qualifications of the स्थापक: the details of the ceremony of worshiping the idol, offerings to the भूतस् in all the three parts of the day: worship in the night time; should have dancing and singing as part of the ritual.
4: Ib. ch. २६३.
The image of शिव to face North only;
5: Ib. २६६. 4.
then Loka- पालस् to be consecrated, and appeased with शान्ति।
6: Ib. २६६. १९-65.
The constituents of अर्घ्य and how it is to be offered;
7: Ib. २६७. 2-२२.
offering of ४० lights.
8: Ib. २६७. २४-28.
^3 Ib. २६४. १३-35.

(I)--the capital of Aila पुरूरवस्;
1: वा. ९१. १८.
origi- nally given to Sudyumna by Manu.
2: Vi. IV. 1. १६.

(II) (प्रतिष्ठा)--capital of Sudyumna and पुरूरवस् on the northern bank of the यमुना, and near प्रयागा;
1: भा. IX. 1. ४२; Br. III. ६०. २१; ६६. २१; M. १२. १८; १०४. 5; १०६. ३०.
offered to Sudyumna and by him to the पुरूरवस्.
2: वा. ८५. २२.

--intermediate creation, description of; interval between two cosmic ages;
1: Br. II. ३१. ११३; M. १४४. १०१; वा. 7. 2-3; ५८. ११२; ६१, १४५ and १४८.
no Pratisandhi between [page२-412+ ३३] one Kalpa and the other; but there is one between the different Manvantaras.
2: Br. II. 6. 2, 3 and १०.

or deluge of all creatures, three kinds: नैमित्तिक, प्राकृतिक and आत्यन्तिक;
1: वा. १००. १३२; Vi. I. 2. २५; 3. २२-5.
the विष्णु पुराण adds a fourth kind--नित्य also called दैनन्दिनि।
2: Ib. I. 7. ४१-4; VI. 3. 1-3; 4. 7; 8. 1.

(II)--a topic of the पुराण: at the evening of the day of ब्रह्मा, प्रलय sets in, when the whole universe appears like an oven with blazing fire. Then come different clouds pouring in torrents everywhere (एकार्- णव)
1: वा. 4. १०; १००. १३३-79.
Lord's sleep in the waters.
2: Ib. १००. १८५-9.
(I)--a Marut of the sixth गण. Br. III. 5. ९७.
(II)--the son of प्रतिहार. वा. ३३. ५५; Vi. II. 1. ३७.
(III)--a son of प्रतीह, versed in sacrificial lore and father of Aja and भूमन्, by स्तुती. भा. V. १५. 5; Br. II. १४. ६६.
(IV)--one of the sixteen ऋत्विक्स् for यज्ञ; from the belly of नारायण. M. १६७. 9. [page२-413+ ३०]
--a ऋ. in the द्रविड country. भा. XI. 5. ४०.
--a tribe of the western regions. वा. ५८. ८१.

--the son of भानुरथ;
1: वा. ९९. २८४.
father of Supra- तीक.
2: Vi. IV. २२. 4.
--a son of Maru and father of कृतिरथ. भा. IX. १३. १६.
--a son of ध्रुवाश्व. M. २७१. 7.
--a son of परमेष्ठि and सुवर्चला (वर्चला- ब्र्। प्।) had three sons through his wife सुवर्चला; an adept in आत्मविद्या. भा. V. १५. 3-5. [page२-414+ २८]
--of the family of परमेष्ठि. Br. II. १४. ६५; Vi. II. 1. ३६.
--a गण of the पिशाचस्. Br. III. 7. ३८२.
--a class of पिशाचस्. Br. III. 7. ३७८.
--a son of दक्षिणी; a तुषित god. भा. IV. 1. 7-8.
--adding salt to food in the presence is forbidden to the Yatis. वा. १८. २०.
--(Pratyagraha-वा। प्।) a son of Uparicara Vasu and a Cedipa. भा. IX. २२. 6. वा. ९९. २२२; Vi. IV. १९. ८१.
--of the Brahma veda. Br. III. 1. २६.
--a son of Caidyoparicara. M. ५०. २७.
--an आर्षेयप्रवर (भार्गवस्). M. १९५. ४३. [page२-415+ २९]

(I)--the stage of the dissolution or with- drawal of creation on the commencement of प्रलय at the end of Kali; then the primordial spirit (अव्यक्त) swallows that which is manifest (व्यक्त): waters swallow the गन्- ध quality of the earth thus plunging the earth in waters; then the रस quality of the waters gets merged in fire which spreads in all directions; the रूप quality of fire is in turn eaten away by wind; this permeates all the ten directions, both above and below; the स्पर्श quality of wind is swal- lowed by आकाशा; the शब्द (sound) quality of which is over- whelmed by भूत and other gross elements; the great souls absorb these (महा); seven प्रकृतिस् one covering the other. Br. II. 6. १४; IV. 3. 1-२१; वा. १०२. 1-2, 5.

(II)--a dharma of the yoga, ruins all विषयस् or sense pleasures.
1: M. १८३. ५४. वा. १०. ७६ and ९३. Vi. VI. 7. ४५.

--at sunset the rays of the sun enter fire and hence the latter is seen in the night; when the sun rises in the morning, fire enters the sun's rays and hence the light of fire is not seen in the day; when the sun is in the middle of the earth night enters the waters and hence they are of the copper colour. In the night day enters the waters and hence waters take the white colour. Thus अहोरात्रस् enter waters. वा. ५०. ११२-17.
